newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican stocks close lower as Wall Street tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Mexican stocks close lower as Wall Street tumbles.

text.p: Mexican stocks could not escape the wave of selling that washed over Wall Street on Friday, closing lower in a day where one of the few bright spots was an initial public offering by broadcaster TV Azteca.
The leading IPC stock index fell below the key 5,000-point support level to 4,956.61 points, off 58 points on the day.
Still, Mexican stocks held up well compared with a big sell-off on Wall Street, where U.S. stocks suffered their second-biggest point loss in history.
Azteca, Mexico's second largest broadcaster, issued shares on the Mexican and New York stock exchanges. Its CPO shares in Mexico rose from an initial offer price of 35.43 pesos to 36.80 pesos.
